name: Dad
source:
Pronouns: He/Him

Nova's father. He's very protective over them, constantly making sure they're doing alright throughout the game.

[spoiler]Like his child, he's a type of "emotional vampire" called a Pathospire. It's implied he broke Ms. B's heart in order to "feed off" her.[/spoiler]
